description: Returns all transaction receipts for a given block.

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number in hexadecimal format or the string latest, earliest, pending, safe or finalized (safe and finalized tags are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum and Arbitrum Nova), see the default block parameter description in the official Ethereum documentation

result.blockHash.description: The hash of the block. null when pending

result.contractAddress.description: The contract address created if the transaction was a contract creation, otherwise null

result.cumulativeGasUsed.description: The total amount of gas used when this transaction was executed in the block

result.effectiveGasPrice.description: The actual value per gas deducted from the sender account

result.gasUsed.description: The amount of gas used by this specific transaction alone

result.logs.description: An array of log objects that generated this transaction

result.logs.address.description: An address from which this log originated

result.logs.topics.description: An array of zero to four 32 Bytes DATA of indexed log arguments. In Solidity, the first topic is the hash of the signature of the event (e.g. Deposit(address, bytes32, uint256)), except you declare the event with the anonymous specifier

result.logs.data.description: It contains one or more 32 Bytes non-indexed arguments of the log

result.logs.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in. null when its a pending log

result.logs.transactionHash.description: The hash of the transactions this log was created from. null when its a pending log

result.logs.transactionIndex.description: The integer of the transaction's index position that the log was created from. null when it's a pending log

result.logs.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in. null when its a pending log

result.logs.logIndex.description: The integer of the log index position in the block. null when its a pending log

result.logs.removed.description: It is true when the log was removed due to a chain reorganization, and false if it's a valid log

result.logsBloom.description: The bloom filter for light clients to quickly retrieve related logs

result.status.description: It is either 1 (success) or 0 (failure) encoded as a hexadecimal

result.to.description: The address of the receiver. null when it's a contract creation transaction

result.transactionIndex.description: An index of the transaction in the block
